exposure: Annual number of births in maternity unit
cohort: 5,360 women who gave birth with a confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection within 7 days from hospital admission in Italy
finding: Despite an observed rising trend in adherence to perinatal good practices, substandard childbirth care was observed during the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic in Italy.
mod_finding: Women who had a cesarean section had notably worse outcomes for all perinatal care indicators compared to those who had a vaginal delivery.
